offer: an ActivityStreams Offer carrying an immutable project-corpus snapshot and attenuated corpus-observation capability
acceptance: an ActivityStreams Accept whose object is a CorpusManagementResult bound to the offered corpus digest
refusal: an ActivityStreams Reject naming the failed precondition without mutating either party's territory
transport-status: value-level conformance only; ActivityPub S2S deployment awaits a settled did:web identity
settlement: No x402 receipt is emitted. Rank-leg negotiation depends on a separately contracted incidence-derived enterprise-observation receipt; full-cocone and physical-unit welds remain separate capabilities.
